desc: A mystical walking spellbook, deep navy leather book with gold corners and a single eye on the cover, two small legs, pages fluttering. Not an animal. High quality 16-bit pixel art game pet, crisp pixels, right-facing 3/4 view, full body with empty margin, dark violet outline, pixel cluster shading with clear light and shadow, palette of lavender, pale violet, cream, ivory and deep navy, no background.
